fixes.title: Unauthenticated Access and IDOR on Student Assessment History & Learning Journeys
fixes.implementation_details: Replaced get_optional_current_student with mandatory Depends(get_current_student) and enforced strict caller ownership: current_student['id'] == student_id or admin/teacher role. Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401; cross-student IDOR attempts return HTTP 403.

fixes.title: Unauthenticated HTTP Execution of MCP Tools and Educational Research
fixes.implementation_details: Added verify_mcp_caller_auth() validating either active student session (Bearer token / HttpOnly cookie) or internal service secret (X-Internal-Token / X-A2A-Internal-Token). Python in-process calls are authorized when request is None.

fixes.title: Unauthenticated Execution of Google ADK Learning Intelligence Analysis
fixes.implementation_details: Implemented verify_adk_caller_auth() enforcing that caller session matches request.student_id or possesses internal service credentials. Verification executes within endpoint body following Pydantic model validation, preserving HTTP 422 contracts for malformed bodies while enforcing 401/403.

fixes.title: Unauthenticated Exposure of System Observability, Execution Traces, and Error Stacks
fixes.implementation_details: Added verify_observability_access() gating telemetry behind valid authentication or internal service secrets. Kept /api/v1/observability/health public for infrastructure probes.

fixes.title: Complete Absence of Toxicity, Profanity, and Abusive Content Moderation
fixes.implementation_details: Created backend/services/content_moderator.py with categorical pattern recognition (abuse, threats, hate speech, explicit content) combined with a CBSE Class 10 Science whitelist ('toxic metabolic waste', 'corrosive acid', 'sexual reproduction in flowering plants', 'killing of microorganisms'). Attached pre-execution hooks to all student input vectors.

fixes.title: Hardcoded A2A Protocol Fallback Secret and Non-Constant-Time Token Comparison
fixes.implementation_details: Removed DEFAULT_INTERNAL_SECRET hardcoded fallback. Made get_internal_a2a_token() fail closed if A2A_INTERNAL_SECRET is missing. Replaced equality comparisons with hmac.compare_digest() for constant-time cryptographic verification.

fixes.title: A2A Student Session Isolation Format Bypass
fixes.implementation_details: Enhanced validate_student_isolation() to query the SQLite student_sessions table for non-colon session identifiers, preventing cross-student session hijacking regardless of string format.

fixes.title: Missing Prompt Injection Guardrails on Student-Facing Endpoints & Brittle Regexes
fixes.implementation_details: Implemented backend/services/prompt_guard.py detecting instruction overrides, role-assumption jailbreaks, system prompt extraction, and delimiter attacks. Reinforced system prompts across canonical agents with explicit anti-jailbreak directives.

fixes.title: Missing Security Headers Middleware and Publicly Exposed API Documentation
fixes.implementation_details: Added SecurityHeadersMiddleware injecting X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block, Referrer-Policy, HSTS, and Content-Security-Policy. Interactive API docs are disabled when ENVIRONMENT == 'production'.

fixes.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication and LLM Inference Endpoints
fixes.implementation_details: Built thread-safe InMemoryRateLimiter sliding-window limiter. Applied enforce_rate_limit(5/min) on auth routes and enforce_rate_limit(30/min) on LLM routes, returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After headers.

fixes.title: Frontend Storage of Authentication Tokens in Browser localStorage
fixes.implementation_details: Enhanced get_current_student() to accept HttpOnly gyaan_auth_token cookie in addition to Bearer tokens. Login/register issue HttpOnly cookies, logout clears them. Next.js apiFetch configured with credentials: 'include'.

fixes.title: Google ADK In-Memory Session Storage Lifecycle and Scale Limitations
fixes.implementation_details: Documented as an accepted architectural limitation for single-process local deployment in PHASE_5B_REMAINING_RISKS.md, with clear Redis/SQLite migration roadmap for clustered production.

fixes.title: Residual Legacy JWT Configuration in .env.example
fixes.implementation_details: Purged legacy JWT_SECRET_KEY, JWT_ALGORITHM, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES from .env.example; documented opaque session tokens, A2A_INTERNAL_SECRET, and TELEMETRY_HMAC_SECRET.

fixes.title: Test Suite Writes Directly to Development SQLite Database Without Fixture Isolation
fixes.implementation_details: Implemented Priority Zero test isolation: dynamic database path selection, fail-safe guard preventing test access to data/gyaan_ai.db, and automatic temporary database fixture in tests/conftest.py.
